description: Source code for a Rust module handling IPC message parcels in Android's binder system, including serialization/deserialization, parcel management, and binder object handling.

classes.name: Parcel
classes.description: Represents a message container for IPC, owning an underlying native AParcel object.

classes.name: BorrowedParcel
classes.description: A borrowed reference to a Parcel, tied to a lifetime, providing access to the underlying AParcel.

classes.name: WritableSubParcel
classes.description: A segment of a writable parcel used for sized writes.

classes.name: ReadableSubParcel
classes.description: A segment of a readable parcel used for sized reads.

methods.name: Parcel::new
methods.description: Creates a new empty Parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::from_raw
methods.description: Creates a Parcel from a raw pointer, taking ownership.

methods.name: Parcel::into_raw
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the native AParcel pointer.

methods.name: Parcel::borrowed
methods.description: Returns a mutable borrowed view of the parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::borrowed_ref
methods.description: Returns an immutable borrowed view of the parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::clone
methods.description: Clones the parcel by copying its contents.

methods.name: Parcel::mark_sensitive
methods.description: Marks the parcel data as sensitive.

methods.name: Parcel::write
methods.description: Serializes a parcelable object into the parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::write_slice_size
methods.description: Writes the size of a slice to the parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::sized_write
methods.description: Performs a sized write operation with a callback.

methods.name: Parcel::get_data_position
methods.description: Returns current data position.

methods.name: Parcel::get_data_size
methods.description: Returns total data size.

methods.name: Parcel::set_data_position
methods.description: Sets the data position (unsafe).

methods.name: Parcel::append_from
methods.description: Appends a subset of another parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::append_all_from
methods.description: Appends entire contents of another parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::read
methods.description: Deserializes a type from the parcel.

methods.name: Parcel::read_onto
methods.description: Deserializes onto an existing value.

methods.name: Parcel::sized_read
methods.description: Reads a sized parcelable with a callback.

methods.name: Parcel::resize_out_vec
methods.description: Resizes an output vector based on parcel data.

methods.name: Parcel::resize_nullable_out_vec
methods.description: Resizes or nullifies an output vector based on parcel data.
